currentGoal: Make cactus hazard tiles easier to see and prevent crit/AOE/indirect touch effects from activating cactus hazards.
workCompleted: Changed cactus hazard tile bases from brown dirt tones to rose/red warning dirt and stubble colors so cactus tiles stand out under the cactus art.
Added a scene-level active-cactus guard and used it in watering-can splash, placement pollination, wildflower pollination, mushroom spores, and combo AOE touch selection.
Added a named shouldComboAoeTouchTile predicate so combo AOE explicitly accepts grown non-cactus tiles and rejects active cactus hazards.
Updated sprinkler automation target selection so grown/regrowing targets exclude active cactus hazards before touch or growth effects run.
Updated animal companion automation target selection so field mouse, rabbit, bee, chicken, sheep, and earthworm helper effects avoid active cactus hazards.
Extended the hazard harness with an AOE cactus regression check: AOE rejects the cactus tile, still accepts a non-cactus grown tile, and does not add Pricked or cactus-cleared stats.
Kept direct player cactus interaction intact: manual and persistent direct touches still route through handleHazardTileClicked.
